authority.change_rule: Institutional concepts in this contract change only through controlled HSF governance review. ERP implementation mirrors these concepts and does not redefine them independently.

OPERATIONAL_ERP.purpose: Protected operational system of record for programme, finance, procurement, inventory, HR, payroll, MEAL-supporting and administrative records.

KNOWLEDGE_HUB.purpose: Controlled institutional knowledge for policies, frameworks, standards, SOPs, ERP documentation, MEAL, communication and brand governance.

PUBLIC_PLATFORM.purpose: Approved website content, public reports, approved statistics, stories and social communication.

evidence_states.RAW: Original operational information before cleaning or verification.
evidence_states.CLEANED: Standardized or corrected information with transformations documented; not automatically verified.
evidence_states.VERIFIED: Evidence checked against the approved verification method/source and accepted as verified.
evidence_states.CALCULATED: Value derived mathematically from stated source data and methodology.
evidence_states.ESTIMATED: Approximate value produced through a stated estimation method.
evidence_states.INFERRED: Reconstructed or reasoned value not directly supported as a verified operational record.

data_classification.INTERNAL: Routine internal information not intended for public publication.
data_classification.RESTRICTED: Highly sensitive operational or personal information requiring strict least-privilege access.

public_repository_rule.principle: Anything committed to a public GitHub repository is treated as publicly accessible regardless of preview PINs or no-index controls.
prohibited: bank credentials or restricted account data

volatile_fact_rule: Current programme counts, coverage figures, staffing figures, beneficiary totals and other changing operational values require a dated approved source and must not be embedded as timeless architecture facts.
programme_activation_rule: A UI module, route, mock-up or draft document does not establish an active HSF programme. Programme activation requires management-approved institutional status.
publication_rule: Public statistics and claims must pass evidence-status review, verification, management approval and publication permission before release.
safeguarding_rule: Use the minimum necessary personal information, protect dignity and consent, and never expose identifiable learner, patient or vulnerable-person operational records through public systems.
